messages.subject: DT and filtered rows _rows_all
parts:
Trying to use tableid_rows_all available from DT package, and this works:

write.csv(myData(),file,row.names = F)


but the following that worked at one time gives an empty table now:

s3=input$report3_rows_all
write.csv(myData()[s3,,drop=FALSE],file,row.names=F)

Any pointer is appreciated.
